_readme: THE QUERY SET: what we measure, so a change can be judged against a baseline.
Every query here is grounded in something true and published: a verified
role, skill, service, place or work. Do not add a query for a skill or a
place the evidence ledger does not support; ranking for a claim we cannot
back is a liability, not a win.
How to use it is in docs/SEO-AEO-AUTHORITY-SYSTEM.md (Measurement). The
baseline block records what a web search returned on 2026-10-02/03,
